payload.content: When computing the difference between two dates in SQLite, use `JULIANDAY(date_a) - JULIANDAY(date_b)` to get the difference in days. Do not subtract date strings directly with `-`; SQLite will coerce them to integers and silently return wrong values.

rationale: Round-3 highest-lift idiom transferred to Spider; promotes JULIANDAY over naive arithmetic on date columns the model encounters in cross-domain schemas.
